Action.RelicHint: This Action is a Relic weapon of this (+N), e.g. a (+2) Longsword. 0 means it isn't a Relic.
Action.EffectSavesHint: Further Saves the Action forces, such as "7 (2d6) and pass [Endure] or be Sickened": Reflex avoids the attack, and a Being it hits then makes this Save. The card and its damage roll get a button for each.
Action.HealingHint: This Action restores HP (Cure Wounds, Regenerate) instead of dealing damage.
Action.ComboHint: A Combo is not an attack of its own: it makes these attacks with one Action.

VAGABOND.ArmorHint: Armor reduces damage taken. Only your best worn Armor counts.

Breather.Hint: Once per Shift, eat a ration and regain HP equal to your Might.
Breather.Title: Breather

Cast.Post: Show the Spell in chat (no Mana, no Check)
Cast.DiceHint: Damage dice: 1, plus 1 per Mana spent on extra damage dice.

Chat.NoActors: Select or target a token you own first.

Damage.ApplyHint: Apply to selected tokens, reduced by Armor.
Damage.IgnoreArmorHint: Weak, or damage from a Status: ignores Armor.
Damage.Immune: {name} is Immune to {type} damage{why}. No damage applied.
Damage.Weak: {name} is Weak to {type} damage{why}: it ignores Armor.
Damage.Vehement: Vehement Magic: dice Explode on a 1
Damage.Berserk: Berserk: damage die up one size

DeliveryArea.glyph: 5' glyph, Cast as a 5' Cube later

Effect.ItemHint: Effects on this Item apply to its owner. Use them for bonuses such as system.bonuses.hpPerLevel or system.bonuses.armor.

Feature.SneakAttackHint: The first time you hit with a Favored attack on a Turn: extra d4s that ignore that much Armor.

Focus.Check: {name} took 5 or more damage while Focusing. Check whether the Focus drops.

Gear.SlotsBonusHint: Extra Inventory Slots while equipped (such as a backpack).

VAGABOND.HPHint: Max HP is Might × Level. Type +5 or -3 to adjust.

Luck.FlukeHint: Spend 1 Luck to reroll the d20.
Luck.Hint: Spend Luck for Favor or a Fluke by lowering it here; every change is noted in chat. Resets on Rest.
Luck.Label: Luck

NPC.TravelHint: Miles per Shift of Travel, for Riding Animals (p. 13). 0 uses Speed / 5.
NPC.CargoHint: Slots it can carry as a pack animal or Mount (p. 13). Players who can see it can store Items on it.

Rest.Confirm: Rest for a Shift? HP and Mana return to max and Luck resets. If HP is already full, 1 Fatigue is removed.
Rest.Restored: HP and Mana restored, Luck reset.
Rest.Title: Rest

Roll.SaveCrit: Crit: unaffected by what provoked the Save, and you can use an Action.
Roll.ModeHint: Every Check rolls with this until you change it. Statuses still add Favor or Hinder, and Favor and Hinder cancel.

SaveHint.reflex: 20 − (Dexterity + Awareness), plus worn Armor's Slots. Dodging attacks and hazards.
SaveHint.will: 20 − (Reason + Presence). Resisting the mind and soul.

Burning.Name: Burning Reminders
Burning.Hint: Whisper the GM when a Burning combatant starts its Turn.

NPCDamage.Name: NPC Damage
NPCDamage.Hint: Roll NPC damage, or use the average printed in the statblock.

SheetLog.Name: Sheet Change Notes
SheetLog.Hint: Post a chat note when a Hero's Mana, Luck, Stats, Skills, Coins, Level, XP, or Items change, naming who made the change.

Vision.Name: Token Vision from Senses
Vision.Hint: Set each Token's vision from its Senses: Darksight sees in the dark, and Allsight, Blindsight, Echolocation, Seismicsense, and Telepathy become detection modes. Tokens only change when the Senses do.

Sheet.NoAttacks: Equip a Weapon to attack with it.
Sheet.TrainingHint: Trained in {count} Skills. At Level 1 you get your Class Trainings plus {bonus} more (half Reason, round up).
Sheet.NoReadiedSpells: No readied Spells. Ready one with the bookmark on the Magic tab.

SkillHint.mysticism: Faith, nature, and the spirit world (Awareness).

Spell.CastSkillHint: Magical Secret: Cast this Spell with its own Skill instead of your Class's.

StatHint.mit: Endurance, strength, and vitality. Sets Max HP, Slots, and Endure.
StatHint.dex: Agility, coordination, and reflex. Sets Speed and Reflex.
StatHint.awr: Accuracy, perception, and wisdom. Reflex and ranged attacks.
StatHint.luk: Destiny, fate, and success. Your Luck pool.

Studied.Label: Studied dice
Studied.Hint: Studied dice: each is a d6 you can spend for Favor on a d20 roll in the next Day (p. 19).
Studied.StudyHint: Study (a Downtime Activity): gain a Studied die, plus one for each Bookworm Perk.
Studied.ArmHint: Spend a Studied die for Favor on your next Check. Used before armed Luck, and turns itself off once used.
Studied.PassHint: Heightened Intellect or Cognition: spend a Studied die to pass this failed Check.
Studied.Passed: {name} spends a Studied die to pass: {check}
Studied.GiveHint: Give one of your Studied dice to an Ally who can see or hear you.
Studied.NoAllies: There are no other Heroes to give a Studied die to.

Weapon.CrudeHint: Breaks on a damage roll of 1, and can use Craft to attack.
Weapon.RelicHint: A Relic deals Relic damage, which gets past Beings Immune to Physical damage from non-Relics. Its Magic Bonus is its (+N).

WeaponPropertyHint.cleave: Ignores Flanked. Reduce its die one size to hit another Target within reach per reduction.
WeaponPropertyHint.defense: On a Reflex Save you can make an Attack Check instead; on a pass, reduce the damage by each equipped Defense Weapon's damage dice.
WeaponPropertyHint.grapple: Can Grapple with the Attack Check.
WeaponPropertyHint.keen: Crits 1 lower on the Attack Check.
WeaponPropertyHint.thrown: Can be thrown to Near, or Far with Hinder, and drawn as part of the attack.
WeaponPropertyHint.vicious: Crits with it deal 1 extra damage die.

Builder.Title: Build Hero
Builder.LevelUpHint: Advance to the next Level and make its choices.

Intro.ancestry: Choose an Ancestry. It sets your Being Type, Size, and Traits.
Intro.class: Choose a Class. It sets your Trainings, Features, and any Magic.
Intro.stats: Pick a Stat Array, then assign its values to your Stats in any order. Your Class's Key Stats get the highest values when you pick an array.
Intro.skills: Your Class and Ancestry Trainings are locked in. Pick the rest: half your Reason (rounded up), plus any your Traits grant.
Intro.perks: Take a Perk. Perks your Class or Ancestry grants are already included. Locked Perks need prerequisites you don't have yet. Some Perks ask you to choose a Spell, Stat, or Training.
Intro.spells: Choose the Spells you know at 1st Level.

Builder.UnmetHint: You don't meet this Perk's prerequisites.
Builder.GearHint: Buy Gear from the Gear, Weapons & Armor compendiums. Starting Packs are on p. 75.
Builder.LimitReached: You've made all the choices allowed here. Unselect one first.
Builder.Missing: Not found in the compendiums, add by hand: {names}
Builder.NoFeatures: No new Features at this Level.
Builder.NoPickFor: {name} doesn't fit any of your remaining Perk picks.
Builder.ApplyFailed: The builder couldn't finish: {error}. Check the sheet before trying again.

Kit.DropHint: Drop Items here to add them to the pack.

CastDialog.CastMaxHint: The most Mana you can spend on one Casting. Keep the Spell Cost at or under it.
CastDialog.OtherCost: 1 Mana each unless the Spell says otherwise
CastDialog.CheckHint: Roll a Cast Check if the Spell Targets unwilling Beings or complex Objects (Traps, etc). Otherwise just post it.
CastDialog.NoDamage: This Spell has no Damage Base, so it is Cast for its effect.
CastDialog.OtherHint: Mana for the Spell's own Upcast options, such as Adhere's effective Level or Aqua's distance.
CastDialog.Focus: Focus on it to keep it active
CastDialog.Check: Make a Cast Check (unwilling Targets or complex Objects)
CastDialog.OverCastMax: Over your Cast Max of {max} Mana per Casting.
CastDialog.KeepFocusHint: Spend 1 Mana to keep Focus this Round (needed when the Spell affects an unwilling Being).
CastDialog.FocusPaid: {name} spent 1 Mana to keep Focus on {item} ({mana} left).

Note.imbue: Spend 1 Mana per Target when the Weapon attacks; its Attack Check is the Cast Check
Note.glyph: Damage and effect are chosen and paid when the glyph triggers

RelicBuilder.Title: Relic Builder
RelicBuilder.FlavourHint: What it looks like, where it came from.
RelicBuilder.CustomHint: For anything the Relic Powers table doesn't cover.
RelicBuilder.PickPowers: Pick powers on the left to see the Relic take shape.
RelicBuilder.FooterHint: Creates a world Item. Drag it onto a Hero or into a compendium.

Applies.weapon: Weapon bonus {n} to attack and damage rolls

Warn.weapon: Weapon bonus only applies to a Weapon base, so it is listed as text.
Warn.armor: Armor bonus only applies to an Armor base, so it is listed as text.
Warn.slots: Holding only adds Slots on a Gear base, so it is listed as text.

CreatureBuilder.Title: Creature Builder
CreatureBuilder.OpenHint: Rebuild this statblock in the Creature Builder
CreatureBuilder.HPHint: HP defaults to HD × 4.5 rounded down (1 per HD for Small Beings). Type a number to override.
CreatureBuilder.TextHint: What happens. The average and dice are added in front of damage automatically.
CreatureBuilder.ComboHint: Name the Actions it makes, e.g. "2 × Claw and 1 × Bite". DPR adds them up.
CreatureBuilder.NoActions: No Actions yet. Add one below.
CreatureBuilder.Formula: TL = (2 × Armor + HP ÷ 10) ÷ 4 + DPR ÷ 6, to the nearest tenth (p. 111).
CreatureBuilder.CompareHint: Typical ranges from the Threat Level table. Arrows show where this creature sits above or below.
CreatureBuilder.FooterHint: Creates a world NPC with a hostile token.
CreatureBuilder.EditHint: Saving replaces this NPC's Actions with the ones above.
CreatureBuilder.BookTL: The statblock lists TL {tl}. Many printed statblocks don't match the formula exactly; saving uses the formula.

FeatureNote.Hint: Worked out for your Level. Values marked as applied are added to your rolls automatically.
FeatureNote.Valor: Applied: Crit on {n}+ (attacks, Saves vs attacks)
FeatureNote.SpellSlinger: Applied: Spell die +1 size, Crit on {n}+
FeatureNote.Footloose: Applied: Reflex Saves roll 2d20, keep higher
FeatureNote.Indestructible: Applied: +{n} per Defense Weapon die (in Armor)
FeatureNote.BadMedicine: Applied: +{n} damage dice on Ranged Crits
FeatureNote.ParagonsAura: Applied: −2 Mana on Aura; Imbue discount {n}

Storage.CapacityHint: Slots it can hold. 0 means no limit.
Storage.Empty: Empty. Drag Items here from a sheet or the sidebar.
Storage.DragHint: Drag Items here from your sheet to store them, or drag them onto your sheet to take them. Hold Shift to move part of a stack.
Storage.TakeHint: Move this to your Hero. Shift-click to take part of a stack.
Storage.DepositHint: Move coins from your Hero into this.
Storage.WithdrawHint: Move coins from this to your Hero.
Storage.LockHint: Locked storage can only be changed by its owners and the GM.
Storage.LockedNote: Locked. Only its owners and the GM can change what's inside.
Storage.NeedGM: A GM needs to be online to move Items you don't own.
Storage.OnlyPhysical: Only Weapons, Armor, and Gear can be stored.
Storage.Missing: That Item or Actor no longer exists.
Storage.NotEnoughCoins: There aren't enough coins for that.
Storage.NoHero: You need a Hero to do that. Ask the GM to assign you a character.

Vehicle.SpeedHint: Combat Speed in feet per Round for anyone aboard.
Vehicle.NoneAboard: No one is aboard. Drop this Vehicle on a Hero's sheet to board it.

Mount.Label: Mount
Mount.DropHint: Drop a Mount or Vehicle here to ride it. You'll use its Speed instead of your own.
Mount.RiderHint: You use its Speed. A controlled Mount uses your Skills for Checks; an intelligent one acts on its own (p. 13).
Mount.VehicleHint: You use the Vehicle's Speed while aboard.
Mount.Invalid: Only Beings and Vehicles can be ridden.
Mount.TooSmall: {name} must be at least one Size smaller than {mount} to ride it (p. 13).

Crit.ChoiceHint: A Crit gives one benefit: Crit damage or 1 Luck.
Crit.Used: This Crit has already been used.

Icons.Migrated: Updated the art on {n} Actors and Items to the system's new icons.
